coverage.notes: Mapped core forwards Plan unchanged, but the concrete activity overload ignores it and calls Invoke-Conduction_SDA with conductor/ConductionSignal only. All three mapped verbs follow the same branch; no incoming Plan property reads and no claimed distinct concrete activity behavior.

All three mapped verbs forward Plan unchanged to the same ST helper; no local activity switch. Direct Plan and original Phases aliases are inventoried. Graph wrapping retains direct phase objects; arbitrary Signal data, other-adapter internal reads and status writes are excluded. Wrapper reads are conditional on graph creation succeeding; no runtime behavior acceptance is claimed.
